topics.definition: Robotics is the field of designing, building and programming robots to perform tasks automatically or with human assistance.
tips: Combine mechanical design with AI for smarter robots.

topics.definition: A robot is a programmable machine that can sense its environment and perform actions.
tips: Robots may be autonomous or manually controlled.

topics.definition: Main components include sensors, actuators, controller, power source and communication system.
tips: Each component has a specific role.

topics.definition: Robots can be industrial, service, medical, humanoid, mobile or autonomous.
tips: Choose the type based on the task.

topics.definition: Sensors collect information about the robot's surroundings.
tips: Use multiple sensors for better accuracy.

topics.definition: Actuators convert control signals into physical movement.
tips: Select actuators suitable for the robot.

topics.definition: Robotics is used in manufacturing, healthcare, agriculture, logistics and space exploration.
tips: Match the robot to the environment.

topics.definition: Design safe, reliable and efficient robots with regular testing.
